description: Planning scaffold for generating collaborative project DAGs. Understands collaboration topic, identifies success criteria, selects dialogue shape (3A-3D), gathers design input, and writes the project DAG.
goal: Enable planning agents to generate valid collaborative project DAGs by understanding the topic, defining success, selecting the right collaboration structure, and setting up the dialogue loop.

context-gather.desc: Need more context about the collaboration topic or constraints
context-gather.choose_when: Understanding of topic, constraints, or context is insufficient

propose-success-criteria.desc: Sufficient context gathered; ready to define success criteria
propose-success-criteria.choose_when: Enough context to understand what makes the collaboration successful

propose-success-criteria.desc: Success criteria need refinement; redefine what success means
propose-success-criteria.choose_when: Proposed criteria don't capture what makes collaboration successful

propose-collaboration-shape.desc: Success criteria are sound; proceed to select collaboration shape
propose-collaboration-shape.choose_when: Success criteria are clear and appropriate

propose-collaboration-shape.desc: Collaboration shape doesn't fit; reconsider dialogue structure
propose-collaboration-shape.choose_when: Proposed shape doesn't support good user-agent collaboration

identify-output-artifact.desc: Collaboration shape is appropriate; proceed to identify output artifact
identify-output-artifact.choose_when: Selected shape fits the collaboration well

finalize.desc: Collaboration plan is sound; proceed to write the project DAG
finalize.choose_when: All collaboration decisions are solid and ready to commit

clarify.desc: Need more understanding of topic or context

propose-success-criteria.desc: Refine what success means for this collaboration

propose-collaboration-shape.desc: Reconsider which dialogue structure is right
propose-collaboration-shape.choose_when: Selected shape doesn't fit the collaboration
